_help: Drives the 'This Saturday's Review' block inside the Study Saturday livestream card on community.html. The entry in 'weeks' whose 'weekOf' date is today-or-earlier AND closest to today is rendered. Add a new entry each week. 'weekOf' format: YYYY-MM-DD (Monday of the week by convention). Both oldTestament and newTestament are optional — if neither is set the review block is hidden.
